Anya (CS): Quick proposal — lightweight 'fast feedback' nudge playbook for newly onboarded accounts that go dark for 72h. Goal: capture enablement feedback, rescue onboarding, and reduce renewal risk.

Jamal: What's the exact trigger and where does the data live? CRM custom field, event stream, or both? Also what sample size for the pilot?

Anya (CS): Trigger idea: use `first_successful_login_ts` (or `crm.custom_fields.onboard_started_at` as fallback) + no engagement events for 72h. Target cohort: accounts with ARR >= $5k or seats >= 10 for focused pilot. Start with a 10% randomized sample to validate.

Leo: A few engineering notes: 1) idempotency is critical — mark `nudge_sent_at` on the account/contact to avoid duplicates. 2) telemetry noise — prefer `last_engagement_ts` based on session pings or event dedup window rather than raw pageviews. 3) contact owner mapping must be present so the playbook can A/B: automated nudge vs AE assist.

Leo: Example SQL filter for the batch selector:
```sql
SELECT account_id
FROM accounts
WHERE first_successful_login_ts IS NOT NULL
  AND last_engagement_ts < NOW() - interval '72 hours'
  AND (arr >= 5000 OR seats >= 10)
  AND status NOT IN ('churned','suspended')
  AND COALESCE(contact_owner_email, '') <> ''
LIMIT 500;
```

Anya (CS): Love it. Can ops/eng add `last_engagement_ts` and `nudge_sent_at` to the playbook consumer feed? Also we should respect `suppress_nudges` tag on accounts.

Jamal: On it — I'll create a small producer job to emit `last_engagement_ts`, `nudge_sent_at`, and `suppress_nudges` into the playbook topic. Will include idempotency token `nudge_id`. ETA: tomorrow morning.

Priya (Enablement): I'll draft two nudge variants: 1) quick checklist + 1-click scheduling link, 2) personalized AE offer for high-ARR accounts. Will post copy here by EOD and coordinate with comms for brand tone.

CS Bot: Automation note — created staging sample run (50 accounts) for pilot verification: run id run_2026-03-20-01. Playbook logs and sample CSV: <https://internal/redwood/playbooks/runs/run_2026-03-20-01>.

Leo: Please also add backoff/escalation policy: 1st automated nudge at 72h, 2nd automated at 7 days, escalate to AE at 10 days if still no engagement. Respect `suppress_nudges` and `do_not_contact` flags.

Anya (CS): Perfect — summary / action items: 
- @Jamal: add fields + idempotency token + produce topic (ETA tomorrow)
- @Leo: implement backoff & escalation config in playbook runtime
- @Priya: produce two nudge copies and scheduling link (EOD)
- @Anya: assemble rollout checklist and sampling plan, post in #cs-ops tomorrow

Anya (CS): Any objections to starting the 10% pilot in staging today and a small prod shadow next week once logs look clean? :thumbsup:

Jamal: No objections. I'll tag the run as "pilot-staging" and add monitoring alert if error rate >1%.

Priya (Enablement): Approved from enablement side. Will prep meeting script for AEs in case escalations spike.

Leo: Fine by eng. Quick ask: include a single feature flag so we can toggle A/B or full cohort without redeploy.

Anya (CS): Will include the flag. Thanks team — I'll post a short checklist and assign the tasks.
